$comment: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (imagodei Attestation entry, kind='steward-of-record-transfer'). Category A. Supersession event for a StewardOfRecordAttestation. Either: (a) authorized by the active custodian alone (typical case — custodian re-delegates stewardship), or (b) authorized by the steward's succession quorum (if custodian is unavailable AND stewardship is hereditary in the quorum's discretion). Reach: commons. Mirrors hardware-custody-transfer shape because the semantics are parallel; the distinction is one tier down in the authority chain.
title: StewardOfRecordTransferAttestationMetadata
description: Per-subtype metadata for attestation:steward-of-record-transfer. Marks the named StewardOfRecordAttestation as superseded. Active operate-doorway Commitments under the previous steward are orphaned until re-blessed by the new steward.

predecessorAttestationHash.description: ActionHash of the StewardOfRecordAttestation being superseded.

outgoingSteward.description: Agent public key of the previous steward (may be null if the predecessor's steward agent is no longer available).

incomingSteward.description: Agent public key of the new steward.

transferReason.description: Why stewardship is changing. 'custody-transferred' indicates this transfer is a downstream effect of a HardwareCustodyTransferAttestation — the new custodian re-blesses (or replaces) the steward as their first act.

authorizationPath.description: Which authority path authorized this transfer. 'custodian-signed' requires the active custodian's signature in witnessSignatures. 'succession-quorum' requires M-of-N from the steward's succession quorum.

recoveryQuorumRequestHash.description: Optional link to a recovery_quorum_requests entry when the authorization path is 'succession-quorum'.
